about.title: La Quinta Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone in a traffic collision changes everything, and it often happens in an instant on roads La Quinta families drive every day. Riverside County's most recent full-year data recorded 100 injury collisions and one traffic death across the city, with reported crashes clustering on Friday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m. along corridors like Washington Street, Highway 111, and Jefferson Street. In the middle of grief, families are often left sorting out medical bills, funeral costs, and unanswered questions about what happened. California law allows certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, to pursue a wrongful death claim. LawProactive is not a law firm; we simply connect you with an independent attorney who can look at your situation, explain your options in plain terms, and help you understand the timeline you're working with. There's no obligation and no fee unless the attorney recovers something on your behalf.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, and then other dependents or heirs. An attorney can walk you through where your family fits before any deadline passes.

items.title: Clarity on What Can Be Recovered
items.desc: Wrongful death claims can account for funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. An independent attorney can help you understand what applies to your circumstances.

items.title: No Upfront Cost, No Pressure
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. You can get informed guidance during a hard time without adding financial strain.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in La Quinta?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, like a public road agency, may be involved, that window can be much shorter, so it's worth speaking with an attorney as soon as you're able.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on compensation for the family, while any criminal charges against the driver are handled independently by prosecutors. Families can pursue a civil claim regardless of the criminal case's outcome or timing.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a specific La Quinta road, like Highway 111 or Jefferson Street?
items.answer: Public collision records for La Quinta show that some corridors, including Washington Street, Highway 111, and Jefferson Street, see higher volumes of reported crashes, which can be relevant to establishing what happened. An attorney can help gather crash reports and other evidence tied to the specific location.
